description: Synthetic acceptance inputs, not recorded user requests or provider responses. Resolve relative dates when running. Success requires semantic review of the route, not HTTP 200 alone.

steps: Create a new route in MAX
expected: Walking intent is retained
A route is more than a single unrelated indoor visit
Insufficient or unverified data is shown explicitly

cases.explicit_api_request: Завтра в Москве с 14:00 до 19:00 хочу погулять, а потом поесть, пешком, без ограничения бюджета
expected: Both activities survive parsing and confirmation
Walking precedes eating
Missing eating cannot be reported as a complete route

cases.request_text: Завтра в Москве с 14:00 до 14:30 хочу музей, затем погулять и поесть, пешком
expected: No visit or travel is scheduled outside the confirmed window
Unmet activities are listed
Partial or unavailable outcome is distinguished from a provider failure

cases.request_text: Завтра в Москве с 14:00 до 19:00 хочу погулять и поесть, бюджет до 1500 рублей на человека, нас двое, пешком
expected: Budget basis, number of people and evidence limitations remain visible
Average check alone is not presented as a guaranteed maximum price

steps: Select actual categories, dates, windows and order
expected: The flow remains available when LLM credentials are absent or the text parser fails
No invented category or provider-free live route is substituted when geography is unavailable
The same constraints and explicit confirmation apply as for free text

steps: Request a replacement for one stop
Inspect the offered itinerary and time/cost difference
expected: Preview leaves the current route intact
Other stops and hard constraints are preserved
Applied result equals the preview without another provider calculation
Stale or expired previews cannot overwrite an edited route

steps: Create a share without private points
Open the MAX link as another authorized test user
Choose a verified city and import
expected: Private points and address queries are excluded by default
Opening alone does not import or send messages
Import creates independent unconfirmed conditions and requires missing points
Expired facts are never revived
Revocation prevents future resolution and leaves an existing independent recipient copy intact

steps: Confirm deletion of one named route
expected: Cancel preserves both
Only the explicitly selected owned route is deleted
Shares of the deleted route stop resolving
A stale revision or foreign route cannot be deleted
Deletion replay is idempotent

steps: When the live capability is enabled, select public transport and an unspecified or unlimited budget
Choose dated activities and public start/finish points
Inspect transit stages and actual departure times
expected: Each selected leg is rechecked at its planned departure
Waiting is included once, not added twice
Mixed vehicle types retain their own line numbers
Unknown fares are not zero; an unsupported finite total budget requires input
A second unstable time check does not return the earlier itinerary
Synthetic provider tests do not prove live key entitlement

steps: Change time, budget or a user-selected map/geolocation start point
Reopen the first via Мои маршруты after provider facts and the draft expire
Choose a fresh verified locality and restore with the latest saved revision
Review issues and dates, confirm explicitly, then calculate
expected: The latest user conditions survive expiration and process restart without an LLM call on read
An expired provider itinerary is not presented as current
Saved map/geolocation coordinates are labeled as a past selected point, not current location
Provider address choices require reselection when they were not user map/geolocation points
Restore creates an unconfirmed draft without a previous provider result
Ambiguous category remapping or missing hard conditions require input rather than silent widening
Another MAX user receives 404 without saved contents
An action with a stale saved revision returns 409 and does not overwrite newer conditions

limitations: Live provider coverage and MAX authorization are not supplied by these fixtures.
No test credentials, personal data or provider snapshots are embedded.
Live checks must record failures honestly; deterministic fixtures cannot substitute for the MAX demonstration.
